en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a small European riverside town. In the foreground is a calm river with reflections of trees and buildings. An old stone bridge crosses the river; part of it is roofed in wood, connecting to a round or polygonal stone gate tower with a steep tiled roof and arched gateway. Beside the tower is a cobbled street lined with modest two‑ to three‑story houses with shuttered windows and tiled roofs. The scene is quiet with no visible people or vehicles, giving a historic, early‑20th‑century atmosphere.
